description: agent-workflows for Codex (named by .codex-plugin/plugin.json, in place of hooks/hooks.json): load the working conventions at session start, gate git commit and push on a passing cw task verify, deny cw task abandon and cw's owner approval for the user to run, and sample the session's usage before cw task commands. Each command passes --host codex and, when an older cw rejects the flag (exit 2), runs it again without the flag, so the gate stays on

hooks.command: f="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/global/AGENTS.md"; if ! command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat "$f"; printf '%s\n' 'agent-workflows: the commit and push verify gate is inactive because cw was not found on PATH. Install cw with `go install github.com/belevtsev/agent-workflows/v3/cmd/cw@v3.0.0-rc.2` (Go 1.27.1 or newer) or from the release archive: https://github.com/belevtsev/agent-workflows/blob/main/docs/operations.md#get-cw'; else out=$(cw hook session-start --host codex --instructions "$f" --cache "${PLUGIN_DATA}" 2>/dev/null); s=$?; if [ "$s" -eq 2 ]; then out=$(cw hook session-start --instructions "$f" --cache "${PLUGIN_DATA}" 2>/dev/null); s=$?; fi; if [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out"; else cat "$f"; fi; fi
command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cw hook pre-publish --host codex 2>/dev/null; [ "$?" -ne 2 ] || cw hook pre-publish; exit 0
command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cw hook task-usage --host codex >/dev/null 2>&1; [ "$?" -ne 2 ] || cw hook task-usage >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
